name: Soulmates
source:
For their anniversary, Lucy and Conrad visit a castle turned escape room, where puzzles slowly reveal its dark history. What begins as a game soon turns sinister, blurring the line between fiction and reality, and forcing the couple to confront the very real ghosts of the past.

[From [url=https://sleepy-d0g.itch.io/soulmates]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了纪念他们的周年纪念日，露西和康拉德参观了一座由城堡改建的逃生室，其中的谜题慢慢揭示了它的黑暗历史。一开始的游戏很快就变得险恶，模糊了虚构与现实之间的界限，迫使这对夫妇面对过去真实的鬼魂。

[来自[url=https://sleepy-d0g.itch.io/soulmates]Itch.io[/url]]
